response.overview: To add another room to a Disney Cruise + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada), book a separate stateroom reservation for the same sailing and link it to your existing booking.  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada) How to Add and Link a Room  1. Book a separate stateroom: Each cabin requires its own reservation number + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada). You can book online, call Disney Cruise Line, or contact your travel agent. If booking online for connecting rooms, finish Stateroom 1, select Add Another Stateroom, toggle on Connecting Staterooms, and click Confirm Travel Party.+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada)  2. Link your reservations: Go to Travel Party Booking or log in to My Reservations on Disney Cruise Line, select your reservation + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada), and choose Add and Link Reservations (or Add a Reservation) to link up to three additional reservations online. Call Disney Cruise Line if you need to link more than four total
